answer_1.quote: By prompting LLMs to generate such war‑rants, we further investigate whether the generated texts are comparable to those of human annotators, thus offering a fast and reliable solution to enrich hateful datasets with explanations...
answer_1.outputs: generated implied assumptions / warrants (explanations) for implicit misogynous messages

answer_2.quote: We report the results using established automatic metrics (BERTScore, BLEU, and ROUGE-L) as well as a manual validation on a subset of 300 messages...

answer_4.quote: We further validate the generated implied assumptions and warrants by manually exploring a subset of 300 messages... We focus only on the best models... Overall, 35% of the generated warrants for ImplicIT-Mis are correct and 32% lead to a correct classification of the messages.
answer_4.guideline: Manual validation assesses the plausibility of warrants and whether they lead to a correct classification of misogyny.
